subject: Fractionated gross-to-net split and intro-locking for Opsync integration
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@opsync.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: opsync-sales@opsync.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner commercial ask — proposal for embedded analytics rev-share and lead protection

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the embed looks promising for our analytics add-on. Our commercial team asked me to capture a simple proposal so we can evaluate economics quickly.

High level asks from Opsync:
- Revenue-share with a sliding scale: higher % for higher gross ARR contribution per quarter.
- Clear lead registration window and intro-lock period (we typically ask 18 months).
- Gross-to-net adjustments (refunds/credits/chargebacks) to be reflected in the waterfall rather than penalizing partner payouts retroactively.
- Simple MOU to start while legal reviews a full reseller agreement.

Can you share a sample waterfall or model we can iterate on? If you have a preferred lock period (we can be flexible between 12–18 months) and any exclusions (internal promos, marketplace credits), please call them out.

Appreciate a one-page starter so we can circulate internally.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Opsync
Direct: +1 415 555 0123

[Attachment: opsync-intro-slide.pdf (stub)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@opsync.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Partner commercial ask — proposal for embedded analytics rev-share and lead protection

Lina —

Great to hear; thanks for the clear asks. I put together a working waterfall and a short set of rules to keep things operationally simple. See attached spreadsheet (revshare-model-v2.xlsx) — highlights below:

1) Sliding % by quarterly contributed gross ARR (pre-credit):
   - 0–50k: 15%
   - 50k–250k: 20%
   - 250k+: 27.5%

2) Gross-to-net treatment:
   - Chargebacks/refunds within 60 days: adjust that quarter only; partner payout recalculated for that quarter (no clawback beyond 1 quarter).
   - Marketplace fees and third-party credits are deducted from gross before computing tiers (we call this gross-to-net line items).

3) Intro-lock / registration:
   - Standard registration window: 12 months from signed SOW.
   - Opsync requested 18 months — we're OK with 15 months standard with ability to extend to 18 for strategic named accounts (mutual registration).

4) Lead protection:
   - Partner must log leads in HubSpot with required evidence (intro email + discovery notes).
   - Duplicate detection rule: if Redwood had substantive sales contact prior to intro, registration is invalid.

5) Escalation & reconciliation cadence:
   - Monthly reporting export and quarterly payment runs. Disputes to be raised within 45 days.

Next steps: 1) confirm the lock period you prefer, 2) we circulate this to Legal for a lightweight MOU, 3) Opsync reviews the attached model and returns inputs.

I’ve CC'd Marissa (commercial ops) and Camila (partner go-to-market) to align on implementation and payout ops.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: revshare-model-v2.xlsx (stub)]

Subject: RE: Partner commercial ask — comments on waterfall / legal checklist

Folks — quick operational notes from Commercial Ops / Legal checklist to speed MOU drafting:

- We prefer not to carry open-ended 18-month exclusivity for partner-registered logos. 15 months OK as Ben suggested; anything longer needs GTM rationale and exec approval.
- For gross-to-net we need explicit definitions in the MOU: list the deductions (refunds, taxes, marketplace fees). We'll attach the standard definition clause.
- Payment cadence: quarterly payouts lagging by one full billing cycle (vendor payable on Q+45).
- Required fields for HubSpot registration: company domain, primary sponsor email, date of intro email, high-level ARR estimate. If Opsync can pre-populate a CSV template for bulk imports that speeds onboarding.

Marissa (commercial ops) will take ops lead on the payout workbook and provide the payment calc tab.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

- Standard registration lock: 12 months.
- Elevation to 18 months if both parties agree in writing and the account is added to a shared "Strategic Named Accounts" list (max 25 accounts to start).

If Opsync agrees, Ben and I will instruct Legal to spin a one-page MOU capturing the waterfall, GTM responsibilities, and the Strategic Named Accounts mechanism. Once Opsync signs the MOU we’ll mail a drafted ops runbook (payment calc + registration CSV template).
